initialJobs.name: male-goals-actions
initialJobs.prompt:
Create ONE premium photorealistic 2x2 transparent sprite sheet for a Vietnamese fitness app. Same fictional Vietnamese man identity as reference, natural short black hair, natural neutral lighting. Exactly FOUR equal SQUARE cells, no gutters, no borders, NO text, no scene backgrounds. Every cell EXACT SAME head-to-hip camera distance, crown top y and shorts waistband y; no legs or feet. Every panel is a DISTINCT ACTION, NOT a standing portrait changing shirts.
TOP LEFT (muscle growth): muscular shirtless man performing a single-arm side-chest/bodybuilding flex, torso 3/4 angled to camera, one forearm curled tight, clearly rounded large deltoids, thick biceps and full projecting chest. Physique mass clearly larger than other models.
TOP RIGHT (strength): man in black training tank top holding a SHORT heavily loaded steel EZ bar at upper abdomen with TWO hands during standing curl, two large black weight discs visible at EACH end, jaw focused and forearms engaged, looking toward bar. Entire compact loaded implement must fit inside cell and be visible at small 130px scale. Do NOT use one little dumbbell or generic relaxed upright portrait.
BOTTOM LEFT (lean / fat loss): lean toned shirtless man in three-quarter SIDE VIEW, head turned slightly down toward own abdomen, wrapping a WHITE measuring tape around his trim waist, both hands clearly handling tape at front, waist must be visible. Narrower shoulders and slimmer arms than muscular man. Do NOT use hands on hips, shirts hiding the waist, or standing face-forward.
BOTTOM RIGHT (healthy movement): everyday-fit man in soft slate T-shirt doing an ACTIVE cross-body shoulder stretch, one arm fully across chest, other hand holding upper arm, torso slightly rotated, relaxed expression looking toward stretch. Clearly distinct silhouette and pose, NOT arms crossed at rest.
Same photographer/lens/light/age/skin tone, actions readable in silhouette at thumbnail size, all subjects/props inside own cell. Neutral charcoal shorts, no belts, no logos, natural anatomy. True transparent alpha around each isolated person. Faces not the main message: body action and props communicate goal. Do not draw a UI or labels.

initialJobs.name: male-body-distinct
initialJobs.prompt:
Photorealistic body-type SPRITE SHEET, exactly THREE equal square columns by TWO equal square rows, no gutters/borders/text. Same fictional Vietnamese adult male as reference. Use the face, hair, skin tone and charcoal drawstring training shorts as identity/wardrobe only. IDENTICAL relaxed FRONT pose, hands slightly away from thighs, identical crown-to-mid-thigh crop, same head size, head top, waistline and shorts hem heights in ALL SIX square cells. Never feet or knees. Consistent natural soft neutral studio lighting, true transparent background.
Six physiques must be CLEARLY different at 150px size by skeleton/muscle/waist silhouette, NOT just ab lines:
TOP LEFT AVERAGE: ordinary untrained man, medium narrow shoulder width, normal modest arms, soft flat-ish abdomen, no visible sixpack.
TOP MIDDLE SOFT: distinctly thicker wide waist and ROUND relaxed belly bulging outward, natural love handles and soft chest/upper arms, no visible abs. Waist substantially wider than average.
TOP RIGHT SLIM: narrow shoulders/small ribcage/THIN arms/skinny thighs, very little muscle, narrow waist. Keep head the same size as other figures; do NOT shrink the whole person.
BOTTOM LEFT MUSCULAR: noticeably large V-shaped upper body, shoulders about 35% wider than average, bulky round deltoids, thick biceps/triceps and projecting pectoral mass, large thighs and clear natural ab definition. Healthy trained muscular man, NOT competition bodybuilder.
BOTTOM MIDDLE LEAN: slim runner/swimmer physique, a very NARROW trim waist, clearly defined but modest flat abdominal muscles, smaller chest and arms than muscular, visibly slender silhouette, lean athletic thighs.
BOTTOM RIGHT BALANCED FIT: healthy everyday moderately fit build, medium shoulder width and medium arms, flat but UNDEFINED abdomen without sixpack, fuller waist than lean and smaller muscles than muscular. This is not the muscular body reused with abs erased.
All six must retain exactly same lens, crop, head scale, identity, upright pose and clothing. No fake before-after claims, no percentages, no measurement labels, no exaggeration of ribs. True isolated cutout alpha, no halos/backdrop/floor shadow.
